title: SB923 (2023 Regular): RELATING TO FIREARMS.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Hawaii) (gun-policy Stage 5, Hawaii); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Hawaii text (Introduced, official copy, https://data.capitol.hawaii.gov/sessions/session2023/bills/SB923_.HTM; sha256 3d2c0cf697c9d41f3ef493fd4e677faf6ae008696078a0f85a0428797b4cd7b3)
provenance.note: As filed. Subsection (c) of HRS 134-4 is amended, with struck text (the within-the-State use, fifteen-day no-permit loan and seventy-five-day out-of-state loan), to limit a rifle or shotgun loan to an adult 21 or older for twelve hours, provided the borrower has a permit or owns or possesses a registered firearm and is not prohibited; it is not quoted because the sentence runs across struck words. Subsection (d) is quoted. No passage vote on file; later amendments are not in the text read.

operative_text: SECTION 2 (HRS 134-4): (d) No person shall knowingly lend a firearm to any person who does not have a permit pursuant to section 134-2, does not own or possess a firearm that is registered pursuant to section 134-3, or is prohibited from ownership or possession of a firearm under section 134-7.
